release_height_pct.label: Release height
release_height_pct.norm: Elite men 113 ± 4% of standing height (guide range)

front_knee_br.label: Front knee at release
front_knee_br.norm: Aim for 160° or straighter at release. Elite men average 167 ± 19°; a straighter front knee goes with faster bowling (r ≈ 0.4)

trunk_forward_br.label: Trunk forward flexion at release
trunk_forward_br.norm: Elite men ~42 ± 5° forward at release (guide range)

trunk_lateral_br.label: Trunk side-bend at release
trunk_lateral_br.norm: Later-injured juniors 50 ± 6° vs uninjured 40 ± 8° (thorax lateral flexion at BR)

trunk_flexion_ffc_br.label: Trunk flexion FFC → release
trunk_flexion_ffc_br.norm: Elite men flex the trunk 31 ± 8° from FFC to release

head_offset_br.label: Head outside front foot at release
head_offset_br.norm: Lateral distance of the head outside the front foot at release (heuristic; 'falling away')

stride_length_pct.label: Delivery stride length
stride_length_pct.norm: Elite men 79 ± 7% of standing height (guide range)

hip_shoulder_sep_bfc.label: Hip-shoulder separation at BFC
hip_shoulder_sep_bfc.norm: >= 30° at BFC classifies a mixed action

back_knee_bfc.label: Back knee at back-foot contact
back_knee_bfc.norm: Injured bowlers 146° vs uninjured 156° at BFC (rear hip/knee)
